limits: Native SGX unavailable on all three designated runners.

Software SGX uses initialized EPCM, explicit supervisor tracking for SGX2 page changes and a caller-supplied platform for SGX1 keys and report MACs. Hardware key derivation, supervisor enclave construction/paging, report-v2 and 256-bit key leaves, CET and XSTATE beyond AVX are outside the qualified profile.
The SMM comparisons bind the two KVM save maps. External device timing and multiprocessor interrupt routing require platform producers.
Length-fault and debug priority on other CPUs and other overlong opcode families require target-specific qualification.
Two lower-paging original KVM tests require LA57. The bound local CPU did not enumerate it.

sgx2_dynamic_pages.mode: x86-64, serialized logical CPU and an imported initialized EPCM
sgx2_dynamic_pages.tracking: Fresh pending EAUG pages need no epoch. A permission restriction or type change requires a supplied tracking result before EACCEPT can retire.
sgx2_dynamic_pages.regression_scope: Full register addresses, ordered SECINFO/source/destination checks, AEX original RIP in SSA, EXINFO address and error code, repeated page-table backing repair and transactional page updates.
sgx2_dynamic_pages.timestamps: RDTSC and RDTSCP produce #UD in SGX1 and #GP(0) at CPL3 in SGX2 when CR4.TSD is set. Otherwise code64 uses the body time source.
